title: Search in a rotated sorted array
summary: A sorted bookshelf was spun around a hidden point; find a book by noticing which half of any split is still in order.
goal: Find the position of the target book on the spun shelf, or −1

mapping.story: A half that is still in order

ladder.name: Check every book
ladder.idea: Walk the shelf from the left until you find the book.

ladder.name: Find the cut, then search one side
ladder.idea: First binary-search for the lowest book (the cut), then do an ordinary binary search on the side that could hold the target.
ladder.insight: Each side of the cut is sorted on its own, so once the cut is known, ordinary binary search works.

ladder.name: One search, checking the sorted half
ladder.idea: At each middle, one half is in order. If the target fits inside that half's range, search there; otherwise search the other half.
ladder.insight: We do not need the cut's exact position. Whichever way the shelf is split, one half is sorted, and a sorted half tells us immediately whether the target can be inside it.

transfer.problem: A circular playlist sorted by track number starts at an unknown track. Find track 42 with few looks.
transfer.explanation: At any split one half is in order; check whether 42 falls inside that half's range and discard the other.

selfCheck: Decides which half is sorted with nums[low] ≤ nums[mid].
Checks the target against both ends of the sorted half.
Returns −1 when the target is missing.
